 SSC Napoli vs Roma Serie A SSC Napoli Roma Fireworks at the Maradona as Allegri and Gasperini draw in Serie A matchday eight clash
 In the eighth round of Serie A , Massimiliano Allegri's Napoli and Gian Piero Gasperini's Roma play out a 3-3 draw . Roma remain unbeaten with 5 wins and 3 draws, moving up to 18 points and staying firmly in the Serie A title race. Napoli sit on 11 points from 3 wins, two draws and 3 defeats. Both teams came into the match on the back of Champions League wins during the week, Napoli against Bodo/Glimt and Roma against Slovan Bratislava. 
 Napoli control the first 50 minutes, going 2-0 up through Anguissa's overhead kick and McTominay's header , before Politano goes close to a third. But, as against Inter, Napoli drop too deep and let Roma back into the match . Roma take control and equalise through two quick goals from Soulé and Balerdi between the 70th and 74th minutes. Just as the momentum swings towards Gasperini's side, McTominay puts Napoli back in front , but Balerdi heads in another equaliser for the visitors in the 89th minute amid protests from Allegri's side. Allegri is sent off. 
 Napoli-Roma 3-3 
 Scorers : 28' Anguissa (N), 48' McTominay (N), 70' Soulé (R), 74' Balerdi (R), 83' McTominay (N), 89' Balerdi (R) 
 Goals and highlights
 89' - Wesley crosses from the right and Balerdi heads in the equaliser. Napoli protest over an alleged foul on Beukema. Allegri also protests and is sent off 
 83' - Spinazzola forces Gollini into a save with a right-footed shot. The move continues, and the ball reaches McTominay, who puts the hosts back in front 
 74' - In a scramble in the Napoli area, Castro chests the ball to Balerdi, who fires a left-footed shot under the bar from close range 
 72' - After a counter-attack, Lang tries a weak right-footed shot that Gollini saves 
 70' - Malen and Soulé exchange passes on the edge of the area before the Argentinian fires a powerful, angled left-footed shot into the net to Meret's right 
 60' - Soulé hits a left-footed shot from outside the area, and the Napoli defence deflects it behind for a corner 
 57' - One-on-one with Gollini, Politano hits a weak, low left-footed shot that the goalkeeper saves 
 50' - Malen tries his luck with a right-footed shot that goes well wide 
 48' - McTominay meets Politano's right-footed cross from the right with a header. Gollini saves, but the ball has already crossed the line. The Scot follows up with his foot, though the header has already put Napoli ahead 
 45' - Cristante heads against the post with Meret beaten 
 44' - Hojlund slaloms down the left and plays the ball into the middle of the area, where Gollini makes a miraculous save from Olivera 
 41' - Politano crosses for Hojlund, who cannot get the right angle on his header and sends it wide 
 37' - From the edge of the area, Hermoso hits a left-footed shot that McTominay deflects narrowly past the post to Meret's right for a corner 
 35' - Lang plays a long ball to De Bruyne, who races towards goal. Gollini comes out of his area to clear, and the ball touches the goalkeeper's arm, though he has it tucked against his body. The Roma goalkeeper then dribbles past Hojlund's challenge and clears 
 28' - Anguissa scores with an overhead kick from the edge of the area, sending the ball just inside the post to Gollini's left. The goalkeeper is probably unsighted by the many players between him and Anguissa 
 26' - Lang delivers a fine cross from deep, but neither Hojlund nor Olivera connects with the ball to volley at goal 
 24' - A clever pass from Soulé finds Malen in a good position, but Meret saves his right-footed shot with his foot 
 21' - Cristante tries a right-footed shot from the edge of the area that narrowly misses the post to Meret's left 
 15' - After Politano's foray is thwarted, the ball reaches McTominay, whose first-time right-footed shot goes straight into Gollini's arms 
 13' - Di Lorenzo's cross causes confusion in the Roma area. Play continues, and Politano sends a left-footed shot over 
 9' - Soulé tries to curl a left-footed shot towards goal, but it finishes well wide 
 5' - A fine through ball from De Bruyne finds Hojlund, but De Roon blocks his attempted shot 
 Official line-ups and match details
 Napoli-Roma 3-3 
 Scorers : 28' Anguissa (N), 48' McTominay (N), 70' Soulé (R), 74' Balerdi (R), 83' McTominay (N), 89' Balerdi (R) 
 Napoli (4-3-3): Meret; Di Lorenzo (80' Spinazzola), Badiashile (52' Beukema), Marin, Olivera; Anguissa, De Bruyne (79' Lobotka), McTominay; Politano (66' Giovane), Hojlund, Lang (80' Vergara). Manager: Allegri 
 Roma (3-4-1-2): Gollini; Mancini (84' Ghilardi), N'Dicka, Hermoso (58' Balerdi); Rensch (58' Molina), De Roon, Pisilli (58' Castro), Wesley; Cristante, Soulé; Malen (84' Mora). Manager: Gasperini 
 Referee : Colombo 
 Booked : Marin (N), Cristante (R), Rensch (R), Balerdi (R), De Roon (R) 
 Sent off : Allegri (Napoli manager)
